rules.title: California FEHA housing discrimination, including source-of-income protections
rules.requirement: Landlords may not discriminate against or harass applicants or tenants based on source of income, including Section 8 and other housing vouchers, or other protected traits. Where a government rent subsidy applies, income standards must be based on the tenant's portion of the rent, and applicants must be allowed to offer alternative evidence in place of credit history. Landlords may still ask about the level or source of income.
rules.quoted_span: For the owner of any housing accommodation to discriminate against or harass any person because of the race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, ancestry, familial status, source of income, disability, veteran or military status, or genetic information of that person.
rules.effective_date_note: Section as amended by SB 267 (Stats. 2023, Ch. 776), effective January 1, 2024. Source-of-income protection predates this amendment.
rules.key_value: No discrimination based on source of income, including vouchers

parsed.doc_summary: Cal. Gov. Code § 12955 (FEHA housing discrimination) as amended by SB 267, effective 2024-01-01. It bars discrimination based on source of income, including housing vouchers. It also limits income and credit standards when a government rent subsidy applies. One screening_restrictions record. The section also has a retaliation-eviction provision in subdivision (f). It is tied to fair-housing activity and is covered by the same section record, not split out.
